mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected rise in UNRATE above 6.5% signals heightened inflation expectations, triggering market volatility and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not turn negative when UNRATE crosses above 6.5%, or t-test p-value exceeds 0.05 in such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in both GDPC1 (GDP) and INDPRO (supply) indicate a contractionary demand-supply imbalance, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect between GDPC1 and INDPRO is not statistically significant (IC < 0.03) or 20-day returns remain non-negative despite the combined signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in HOUST (demand) during a late-cycle expansion signals strong near-term growth expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: IC < 0.03 over the horizon or 20-day returns do not turn positive when HOUST crosses above 850 in the 'late-cycle demand surge' regime.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected surge in CPIAUCSL above 220 signals accelerating inflation, prompting market sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: IC < 0.03 in such periods or 20-day returns remain non-negative when CPIAUCSL crosses above 220.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in PAYEMS above 140,000 indicates a robust labor market, fostering investor confidence and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: IC < 0.03 over the horizon or 20-day returns do not turn positive when PAYEMS crosses above 140,000 in the 'strong labor market expansion' regime.

mechanism_narrative: Contra-trend movement in FEDFUNDS (upward) and GDPC1 (downward) creates policy uncertainty, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 is not statistically significant (IC < 0.03) or 20-day returns remain non-negative despite the combined signal.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in RSAFS (demand) and decline in UNRATE (inflation) during post-shock recovery indicates improving fundamentals, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses below 6.0% and RSAFS remains above 350000
failure_condition: The interaction between RSAFS and UNRATE is not statistically significant (IC < 0.03) or 20-day returns do not turn positive when the trigger occurs in the 'post-shock recovery' regime.
